pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/observability/performance-view/PerformanceHealthPanel.tsx:77 In real mode a failed observability fetch leaves the health-issue list empty (PerformanceView.tsx:66 returns [] when not demo), so this branch says "All systems healthy / no issues detected" under the error banner, which is an error shown as a settled empty.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/observability/PerformanceView.tsx:66 The charts get a `failed` prop (line 141), but the health list does not, so an error with no data reaches the empty branch and shows allSystemsHealthy. Rule 4 says error never wears the empty state's clothes.

src/components/dashboard/views/sla/sla-page/SLABreachLog.tsx:121 When a severity chip (zero-count chips can still be chosen) empties the breach log, it shows the generic 'no breaches' copy instead of a filter-caused empty worded from the applied predicate. The health panel gets this right at PerformanceHealthPanel.tsx:89 (noSeverityIssues).
